statement: Lambda listed NVIDIA B200 SXM6 on-demand cloud capacity at $6.69 per GPU per hour in the 8x configuration on 2026-07-29.
why: A published vendor on-demand rental rate for current-generation accelerators is a static price level with no baseline or change stated on the page.

impact.mechanism: Rental rates set the cost of renting rather than buying accelerators; recorded here as a display-only price level with no stated direction of change.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA B200 SXM6: 8x configuration "$6.69" per GPU/hour

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published list price read directly from the live pricing page, but this is an open-web secondary source with no prior baseline for comparison.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.79 -> 6.69 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda GPU Cloud pricing page
